sellThenNews.title: WSB 情绪分析
sellThenNews.description: r/wallstreetbets 2026 年 6 月 25 日情绪分析。讨论最多的股票代码：MU、MSFT、AAPL、SPY、NVDA。人工智能生成的零售流程、牛市/熊市叙述和关键主题的摘要。

sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要事件：

  • Micron’s (MU) earnings nuclear bomb continued to dominate the entire market: Q3 revenue was $41.46 billion (far above expectations of about $35.9 billion), adjusted EPS was $25.11, gross margin hit a record of about 84.6%, 2026 HBM capacity has been fully sold out under fixed-price contracts, and $2.2 billion in signed orders are on hand. Intraday (13:10 ET), MU was +16.7% at $1223, rebounding after being smashed from an overnight high of $1254 to $1137. The community unanimously concluded that “the shovel sellers became the only winners.”
  • Apple’s (AAPL) official announcement of Mac/iPad price hikes triggered market-wide panic: Cook said memory price increases made price hikes “unavoidable,” calling it a “once-in-a-century flood.” DRAM rose as much as 98% in Q1 and another 58-63% this quarter (iPhone unaffected). AAPL was -5.5% intraday at $277, wiping out half a year of gains in a single day and becoming the biggest drag on the market today — “price hikes are no longer bullish” became the community’s new consensus.
  • Memory/semiconductor equipment stocks broadly rose, while Mag7 collapsed collectively in a severe divergence: SNDK +18.9% ($2281, gains surpassing MU), WDC +5.9%, AMAT +10.8%, QCOM +8.3%, AMD +1.2%; meanwhile MSFT -3.7% hit a 52-week low of $350.87, AAPL -5.5%, PLTR -5.5%, AMZN -2.5%, ORCL -3.4%, META -2.3%, NVDA -2.0% fell below $195, with only TSLA relatively resilient (-0.4%).
  • Indexes were forcibly held up by memory-stock weights, while internals were extremely fractured: QQQ +0.79% ($716, rebounding from an intraday low of $705) was supported by MU/SNDK weights, SPY was almost flat ($733, -0.02%, narrow tug-of-war in the $729-$739 intraday range), DIA +0.30%, IWM +0.57%. 9 of the top 10 weighted stocks were red while the index turned green, which the community called an “underwater slow-motion crash.”
  • PCE inflation and rate-hike expectations heated up: May core PCE was about 3.4% YoY, headline about 4%, and final Q1 GDP about 1.6%. CME data showed the probability of a rate hike by the end of October at about 50% and December near 67%; the transmission chain of “memory price hikes → sticky inflation → delayed rate cuts” was repeatedly cited.
  • Geopolitical disturbance (mostly community rumors): Rumors circulated that oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz were threatened by “unidentified objects” near a new route off the coast of Oman; Iran reportedly demanded that Israel withdraw from Lebanon, while Netanyahu publicly refused to withdraw troops. But oil-price reaction was muted, drawing ridicule that it was “priced like the conflict never happened.”

社区氛围：今天的基调是极度疲惫、混乱、崩溃，夹杂着黑色幽默——多头和空头都被“勒死”。散户交易者普遍认为，无论他们买入看涨期权还是看跌期权，他们都被西塔和窄幅震荡所吞噬。市场被“操纵/钉住”的信念达到了顶峰，唯一的快乐来自于做空 MSFT/MSTR 和满仓买入内存股的赢家。

恐慌/贪婪程度：倾向于看跌的恐慌，但高度破碎。 VIX多次被嘲笑为“还没死”，指数层面并未出现恐慌，但个股层面（MSFT三周-24%，AAPL一日-5.5%，PLTR -5.5%，MSTR -9%），已经是局部熊市水平。社区的情绪是：“指数假装睡觉，而血液却在下面流淌。”

情绪与实际价格走势：社区高呼“崩盘”和“熊市”，但 QQQ 实际上上涨了 0.8%，SPY 持平——典型的“叙事比价格更恐慌”。真正的差异在于权重股的大幅下跌被内存股的权重所抵消。零售交易者的实际持有量（主要是Mag7或期权）远低于指数，产生了强烈的“被欺骗”的感觉。
